claim: The long-standing conflict-resource political economy in jade is linked to military and military-connected revenue channels observed in the 2021 source corpus.
The jade political economy provides an actor-specific revenue channel for KIO/A through access fees and taxation.
The jade economy is linked to identified Arakan Army revenue streams, but this does not imply that all post-coup resistance shares the same financing model.
Military constitutional/institutional autonomy coexisted with military control of major holding companies, creating a structural economic base independent of ordinary civilian political competition.
Decades of military-dominated state formation are a plausible institutional precursor to continued military ownership/control of major commercial assets.
